thread:
maya.docs: tiny PR up that consolidates a compact function/tool-calling example for quickstart + SDK pages. Goals: single minimal snippet, show JSON-schema with nullability, a one-line regex fallback hint, and fix two stale links. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pulls/3789 :sparkles:

hiro.eng: drop the snippet here so SDK folks can confirm method names. keep it very short for the quickstart.

maya.docs: sure, here's the proposed minimal example (non-streaming variant):

maya.docs: ```json
{
  "tool": "user.lookup",
  "input": {"email": "alice@example.com"},
  "schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":["string","null"]},"name":{"type":["string","null"]}},"required":["id"]}
}
```

zoe.sdk: Looks good. confirm client method name is user.lookup in our SDKs. two tiny asks: 1) allow name null (already done), 2) add a one-line fallback regex comment like `// fallback: /id:\s*([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)/` so readers can copy it.

hiro.eng: also add `(assumes non-streaming response)` in the snippet text. for streaming responses we need incremental parsing and reassembly notes — we'll point to the full guide.

maya.docs: updated in PR: method confirmed as user.lookup, included the regex fallback comment and the parenthetical about non-streaming responses. i also fixed links: `/guides/tool-calling` -> `/docs/tool-calling` and removed a dead anchor in `/docs/structured-output#patterns`.

fixit-bot: link-checker: 2 broken links fixed, 0 remaining. docs-lint: passed. snippets-smoke: passed.

casey.prod: can someone approve? want to land before the release cut. quick suggestion: add a one-line pointer comment `// full example: /docs/structured-output#streaming` so readers can find the advanced version.

zoe.sdk: approving. added the pointer suggestion.

maya.docs: added the pointer, pushed. merging after changelog entry.

hiro.eng: i'll add a note in the Dedicated runbook about streaming parse caveats and link to the advanced example.

maya.docs: merged and backported to stable. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
